name: LDM.delivery
description: Email delivery API for AI agents. Pay only for delivered inbox messages.
capabilities_note: This is a static pointer card served on the brand/app domain (issue #476, ldm/ldm3). It intentionally does not enumerate capabilities — a static file would go stale as the API grows. Fetch capabilities_endpoint for the live, curated capability list, or append ?full=1 there for the complete catalog.

mcp.note: Streamable-HTTP MCP gateway. Authorization: Bearer ldm_<key>, or connect with no key for an anonymous bootstrap session (ldm_health / ldm_terms / ldm_register).

body.note: Self-serve signup was removed in 2026-05. Log in via the CRM and mint a key, or bootstrap without one via the MCP endpoint above (ldm_register).
